```{r}
# 1. Read your data
bgc <- read_csv("bgc_class_dataset_clustering.csv")  
antismash <- read.csv("antismash_names.csv")

bgc_with_node <- bgc %>%
  mutate(
    node_clean = str_remove(orig_filename, "\\.region.*$")
  )
merged <- bgc_with_node %>%
  left_join(antismash, by = c("node_clean" = "node"))

metadata <- read_csv("Metadata_combined.csv")
metadata_long <- metadata %>%
  select(Sample_Name, Other_Name, everything()) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(Sample_Name, Other_Name),
    names_to = "name_type",
    values_to = "file"
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(file), file != "") %>%
  distinct(file, .keep_all = TRUE)

df_1 <- merged %>%
  left_join(metadata_long, by = "file")

nadf <- df_1 %>% filter(is.na(`cb-broad-desc`))

df <- df_1 %>% 
  filter(!is.na(`cb-broad-desc`))
```


```{r}
class_summary <- df %>%
  group_by(dataset_name, class_name) %>%
  summarise(count = n(), .groups = "drop")

# 2️⃣ Plot relative % (stacked to 100)
ggplot(class_summary,
       aes(x = dataset_name, y = count, fill = class_name)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "fill") +  # <-- fill makes it % of total
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent) +
  scale_fill_viridis_d(option = "turbo") +
  labs(title = "Relative Distribution of BGC chemical classes by location",
       x = "Location (dataset_name)",
       y = "Percent",
       fill = "Chemical class") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30, hjust = 1))
```

```{r}
subclass_summary <- df %>%
  count(dataset_name, class_name, subclass_name, name="count") %>%
  group_by(dataset_name, class_name) %>%
  mutate(p = count / sum(count)) %>%
  ungroup()

ggplot(subclass_summary, aes(x = dataset_name, y = p, fill = subclass_name)) +
  geom_col() +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent) +
  facet_wrap(~class_name, scales = "free_x") +
  labs(title = "Subclass composition within each class",
       x = "Location", y = "Within-class relative abundance") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30, hjust = 1),
        legend.position = "none")
```

```{r}
subclass_summary <- df %>% count(dataset_name, subclass_name, name="count")

heat_df <- subclass_summary %>%
  group_by(dataset_name) %>%
  mutate(p = count / sum(count)) %>%
  ungroup()

ggplot(heat_df, aes(y = dataset_name, x = subclass_name, fill = p)) +
  geom_tile() +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(labels = scales::label_percent()) +
  labs(title = "Subclass relative abundance heatmap",
       y = "Dataset", x = "Subclass", fill = "Rel. abundance") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 18, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 14, margin = margin(t = 10)),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 14, margin = margin(r = 10)),
    axis.text.y  = element_text(size = 12),
    axis.text.x  = element_text(size = 7, angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 1),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 12),
    legend.text  = element_text(size = 10),
    plot.margin  = margin(10, 30, 10, 10)
  )
```


```{r}
library(colorspace)

# Dataset_name (any number of levels)
dataset_levels <- unique(row_meta$dataset_name)
dataset_cols <- setNames(
  colorspace::rainbow_hcl(length(dataset_levels)),
  dataset_levels
)

# cb-narrow-desc
narrow_levels <- unique(row_meta$`cb-narrow-desc`)
narrow_cols <- setNames(
  colorspace::rainbow_hcl(length(narrow_levels), c = 70, l = 70),
  narrow_levels
)

# cb-broad-desc
broad_levels <- unique(row_meta$`cb-broad-desc`)
broad_cols <- setNames(
  colorspace::rainbow_hcl(length(broad_levels), c = 60, l = 65),
  broad_levels
)

# Class (column annotation)
class_levels <- unique(col_class)
class_cols <- setNames(
  colorspace::rainbow_hcl(length(class_levels), c = 75, l = 60),
  class_levels
)

# Assign to row annotation
row_cols <- list(
  dataset_name     = dataset_cols,
  `cb-narrow-desc` = narrow_cols,
  `cb-broad-desc`  = broad_cols
)

bottom_ha <- HeatmapAnnotation(
  Class = col_class,
  col   = list(Class = class_cols),
  which = "column",
  simple_anno_size   = unit(4,"mm"),
  annotation_name_gp = gpar(fontsize = 0),
  show_legend        = FALSE
)

right_ha <- rowAnnotation(
  dataset_name     = row_meta$dataset_name,
  `cb-narrow-desc` = row_meta$`cb-narrow-desc`,
  `cb-broad-desc`  = row_meta$`cb-broad-desc`,
  col = row_cols,
  simple_anno_size   = unit(3,"mm"),
  annotation_name_gp = gpar(fontsize = 0),
  show_legend        = FALSE
)


```






```{r}
### 1. Relative abundance
rel_df <- df %>%
  count(dataset_name, subclass_name, name = "count") %>%
  group_by(dataset_name) %>%
  mutate(p = count / sum(count)) %>%
  ungroup()

### 2. superclass mapping
class_map <- df %>%
  distinct(subclass_name, class_name)

### 3. Matrix
mat_df <- rel_df %>%
  select(dataset_name, subclass_name, p) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = subclass_name,
              values_from = p,
              values_fill = 0)

mat <- as.matrix(mat_df[,-1])
rownames(mat) <- mat_df$dataset_name

### 4. order subclasses by class
sub_order <- class_map %>%
  arrange(class_name, subclass_name) %>%
  pull(subclass_name)

mat <- mat[, sub_order]

col_class <- class_map$class_name[
  match(colnames(mat), class_map$subclass_name)
]

### 5. superclass colors
class_levels <- unique(col_class)
class_cols <- setNames(
  brewer.pal(length(class_levels), "Set2"),
  class_levels
)

### 6. bottom annotation (instead of top)
bottom_ha <- HeatmapAnnotation(
  Class = col_class,
  col = list(Class = class_cols),
  show_annotation_name = TRUE,
  annotation_name_gp   = gpar(fontsize = 12),
  simple_anno_size     = unit(4, "mm")
)

### 7. cluster datasets
#row_dist <- vegdist(mat, method = "hellinger")
#row_hc <- hclust(row_dist, method = "average")
comm_hel <- decostand(mat, "hellinger")
row_dist <- dist(comm_hel)   # Euclidean on Hellinger-transformed data
row_hc <- hclust(row_dist, method = "ward.D2")


### 8. colors for abundance
col_fun <- colorRamp2(
  c(0, 0.05, 0.10, max(mat)),
  c("white", "#440154FF", "#21908CFF", "#FDE725FF")
)

### 9. heatmap
ht <- Heatmap(
  mat,
  name  = "Rel. abundance",
  col   = col_fun,
  cluster_rows    = row_hc,
  cluster_columns = FALSE,
  bottom_annotation = bottom_ha,
  row_names_side = "left",
  column_names_side = "bottom",
  row_names_gp    = gpar(fontsize = 14),
  column_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 10),
  column_names_rot = 90,
  heatmap_legend_param = list(
    title_gp  = gpar(fontsize = 14),
    labels_gp = gpar(fontsize = 12),
    legend_height = unit(4, "cm")
  )
)

### 10. Draw BIG heatmap
png("subclass_heatmap_large_hellinger.png", width = 3200, height = 2000, res = 300)
draw(ht)
dev.off()

```
```{r}

# -------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 0) Assumptions about df:
#    Columns: file, subclass_name, class_name,
#             dataset_name, cb_narrow_desc, cb_broad_desc
# -------------------------------------------------------------------------

# 1) Build abundance matrix: counts per file × subclass --------------------

abund_df <- df %>%
  count(file, subclass_name, name = "count")

mat_df <- abund_df %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from  = subclass_name,
    values_from = count,
    values_fill = 0
  )

mat <- as.matrix(mat_df[, -1])
rownames(mat) <- mat_df$file

# -------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 2) Subclass → class mapping + column ordering ---------------------------

class_map <- df %>%
  distinct(subclass_name, class_name)

sub_order <- class_map %>%
  arrange(class_name, subclass_name) %>%
  pull(subclass_name)

sub_order <- intersect(sub_order, colnames(mat))
mat <- mat[, sub_order, drop = FALSE]

col_class <- class_map$class_name[
  match(colnames(mat), class_map$subclass_name)
]

# -------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 3) Column annotation: Class (superclass) --------------------------------

class_levels <- unique(col_class)
class_cols <- setNames(
  brewer.pal(max(3, length(class_levels)), "Set2")[seq_along(class_levels)],
  class_levels
)

bottom_ha <- HeatmapAnnotation(
  Class = col_class,
  col   = list(Class = class_cols),
  which = "column",
  simple_anno_size   = unit(4, "mm"),
  annotation_name_gp = gpar(fontsize = 10),
  show_legend = FALSE
)

# -------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 4) Row annotations: dataset_name + cb_narrow_desc + cb_broad_desc -------

row_meta <- df %>%
  distinct(file, dataset_name, `cb-narrow-desc`, `cb-broad-desc`)

row_meta <- row_meta[match(rownames(mat), row_meta$file), , drop = FALSE]

dataset_levels <- unique(na.omit(row_meta$dataset_name))
narrow_levels  <- unique(na.omit(row_meta$`cb-narrow-desc`))
broad_levels   <- unique(na.omit(row_meta$`cb-broad-desc`))

row_cols <- list(
  dataset_name = setNames(
    brewer.pal(max(3, length(dataset_levels)), "Set3")[seq_along(dataset_levels)],
    dataset_levels
  ),
  cb_narrow_desc = setNames(
    brewer.pal(max(3, length(narrow_levels)), "Paired")[seq_along(narrow_levels)],
    narrow_levels
  ),
  cb_broad_desc = setNames(
    brewer.pal(max(3, length(broad_levels)), "Dark2")[seq_along(broad_levels)],
    broad_levels
  )
)

right_ha <- rowAnnotation(
  dataset_name   = row_meta$dataset_name,
  cb_narrow_desc = row_meta$`cb-narrow-desc`,
  cb_broad_desc  = row_meta$`cb-broad-desc`,
  col = row_cols,
  simple_anno_size   = unit(3, "mm"),
  annotation_name_gp = gpar(fontsize = 10),
  show_legend = FALSE
)

# -------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 5) Row clustering using Hellinger distance ------------------------------

# Hellinger transform on abundance matrix
mat_hel <- decostand(mat, method = "hellinger")

# Euclidean on Hellinger-transformed rows
row_dist <- dist(mat_hel, method = "euclidean")
row_hc   <- hclust(row_dist, method = "ward.D2")

# -------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 6) Color scale for abundance counts -------------------------------------

vals <- as.numeric(mat)
vals <- vals[vals > 0]

if (length(vals) == 0) stop("All counts are zero; check abund_df / df$file.")

q <- quantile(vals, probs = c(0, 0.5, 0.9, 0.99), na.rm = TRUE)

col_fun <- colorRamp2(
  c(0, q[2], q[3], q[4]),
  c("white", "#440154FF", "#21908CFF", "#FDE725FF")
)

# -------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 7) Heatmap: file × subclass, no row names, with annotations  ------------

ht <- Heatmap(
  mat,
  name = "Abundance",
  col  = col_fun,
  cluster_rows    = row_hc,
  cluster_columns = FALSE,
  bottom_annotation = bottom_ha,
  right_annotation  = right_ha,
  show_row_names    = FALSE,        # <- don't print file names
  column_names_gp   = gpar(fontsize = 7),
  column_names_rot  = 90,
  heatmap_legend_param = list(
    title_gp  = gpar(fontsize = 12),
    labels_gp = gpar(fontsize = 10)
  )
)

# -------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 8) Draw (simple version; let ComplexHeatmap handle legends automatically)
# -------------------------------------------------------------------------

# To view in RStudio:
draw(ht)

# Or to save:
# png("file_subclass_abundance_heatmap_hellinger.png", width = 4200, height = 2400, res = 300)
# draw(ht, newpage = TRUE)
# dev.off()

```

```{r}

# Optional: silence ComplexHeatmap messages
ht_opt$message = FALSE 

# -------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Assumes df has at least:
#   file, subclass_name, class_name,
#   dataset_name, cb_narrow_desc, cb_broad_desc
# -------------------------------------------------------------------------

# 1) Relative abundance per file × subclass --------------------------------

rel_df <- df %>%
  count(file, subclass_name, name = "count") %>%
  group_by(file) %>%
  mutate(p = count / sum(count)) %>%   # relative abundance within each file
  ungroup()

mat_df <- rel_df %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from  = subclass_name,
    values_from = p,
    values_fill = 0
  )

mat <- as.matrix(mat_df[, -1])
rownames(mat) <- mat_df$file

# 2) Subclass → class_name mapping + column order --------------------------

class_map <- df %>%
  distinct(subclass_name, class_name)

sub_order <- class_map %>%
  arrange(class_name, subclass_name) %>%
  pull(subclass_name)

sub_order <- intersect(sub_order, colnames(mat))
mat <- mat[, sub_order, drop = FALSE]

col_class <- class_map$class_name[
  match(colnames(mat), class_map$subclass_name)
]

# 3) Column annotation: Class (superclass), labels removed -----------------

class_levels <- unique(col_class)
class_cols <- setNames(
  brewer.pal(max(3, length(class_levels)), "Set2")[seq_along(class_levels)],
  class_levels
)

bottom_ha <- HeatmapAnnotation(
  Class = col_class,
  col   = list(Class = class_cols),
  which = "column",
  simple_anno_size   = unit(4, "mm"),
  annotation_name_gp = gpar(fontsize = 0),  # hide "Class" text
  show_legend        = FALSE                # no annotation legend
)

# 4) Row annotations: dataset_name + cb_narrow_desc + cb_broad_desc --------

row_meta <- df %>%
  distinct(file, dataset_name, `cb-narrow-desc`, `cb-broad-desc`)

row_meta <- row_meta[match(rownames(mat), row_meta$file), , drop = FALSE]

dataset_levels <- unique(na.omit(row_meta$dataset_name))
narrow_levels  <- unique(na.omit(row_meta$`cb-narrow-desc`))
broad_levels   <- unique(na.omit(row_meta$`cb-broad-desc`))

row_cols <- list(
  dataset_name = setNames(
    brewer.pal(max(3, length(dataset_levels)), "Set3")[seq_along(dataset_levels)],
    dataset_levels
  ),
  cb_narrow_desc = setNames(
    brewer.pal(max(3, length(narrow_levels)), "Paired")[seq_along(narrow_levels)],
    narrow_levels
  ),
  cb_broad_desc = setNames(
    brewer.pal(max(3, length(broad_levels)), "Dark2")[seq_along(broad_levels)],
    broad_levels
  )
)

right_ha <- rowAnnotation(
  dataset_name   = row_meta$dataset_name,
  cb_narrow_desc = row_meta$`cb-narrow-desc`,
  cb_broad_desc  = row_meta$`cb-broad-desc`,
  col = row_cols,
  simple_anno_size   = unit(3, "mm"),
  annotation_name_gp = gpar(fontsize = 0),  # hide annotation labels
  show_legend        = FALSE                # no annotation legends
)

# 5) Row clustering using Hellinger distance -------------------------------

# Hellinger transform on relative-abundance matrix
mat_hel <- decostand(mat, method = "hellinger")

# Euclidean distance on Hellinger-transformed rows
row_dist <- dist(mat_hel, method = "euclidean")

# Ward.D2 clustering
row_hc <- hclust(row_dist, method = "ward.D2")

# 6) Color scale for relative abundance -----------------------------------

max_val <- max(mat, na.rm = TRUE)

col_fun <- colorRamp2(
  c(0, 0.01, 0.05, max_val),
  c("white", "#440154FF", "#21908CFF", "#FDE725FF")
)

# 7) Heatmap: file × subclass, no row names, no annotation text ------------

ht <- Heatmap(
  mat,
  name = "Rel. abundance",
  col  = col_fun,
  cluster_rows    = row_hc,
  cluster_columns = FALSE,
  bottom_annotation = bottom_ha,
  right_annotation  = right_ha,
  show_row_names    = FALSE,              # don't print file names
  column_names_gp   = gpar(fontsize = 7),
  column_names_rot  = 90,
  heatmap_legend_param = list(
    title_gp  = gpar(fontsize = 12),
    labels_gp = gpar(fontsize = 10)
  ),
  use_raster = FALSE                      # 🔴 turn off raster to avoid temp-file error
)

# 8) Save to PDF (recommended for big heatmaps) ----------------------------

pdf("file_subclass_rel_abundance_heatmap_hellinger.pdf",
    width = 18, height = 10)
draw(ht, newpage = TRUE)
dev.off()

# If you also want a PNG, you can do:
# png("file_subclass_rel_abundance_heatmap_hellinger.png",
#     width = 4200, height = 2400, res = 300)
# draw(ht, newpage = TRUE)
# dev.off()

```
```{r}
# Silence ComplexHeatmap messages
ht_opt$message = FALSE

# -------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Assumes df has at least:
#   file, subclass_name, class_name,
#   dataset_name, `cb-narrow-desc`, `cb-broad-desc`
# -------------------------------------------------------------------------

# 1) Relative abundance per file × subclass --------------------------------

rel_df <- df %>%
  count(file, subclass_name, name = "count") %>%
  group_by(file) %>%
  mutate(p = count / sum(count)) %>%
  ungroup()

mat_df <- rel_df %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from  = subclass_name,
    values_from = p,
    values_fill = 0
  )

mat <- as.matrix(mat_df[, -1])
rownames(mat) <- mat_df$file

# 2) Subclass → class_name mapping + column order --------------------------

class_map <- df %>%
  distinct(subclass_name, class_name)

sub_order <- class_map %>%
  arrange(class_name, subclass_name) %>%
  pull(subclass_name)

sub_order <- intersect(sub_order, colnames(mat))
mat <- mat[, sub_order, drop = FALSE]

col_class <- class_map$class_name[
  match(colnames(mat), class_map$subclass_name)
]

# 3) Column annotation: Class, labels removed ------------------------------

class_levels <- unique(col_class)

class_cols <- setNames(
  brewer.pal(max(3, length(class_levels)), "Set2")[seq_along(class_levels)],
  class_levels
)

bottom_ha <- HeatmapAnnotation(
  Class = col_class,
  col   = list(Class = class_cols),
  which = "column",
  simple_anno_size   = unit(4, "mm"),
  annotation_name_gp = gpar(fontsize = 0),  # hide label
  show_legend        = FALSE
)

# 4) Row metadata (complete coverage of matrix rows) -----------------------

row_meta_raw <- df %>%
  distinct(file, dataset_name, `cb-narrow-desc`, `cb-broad-desc`)

# Ensure every row in mat appears once in row_meta
row_meta <- tibble(file = rownames(mat)) %>%
  left_join(row_meta_raw, by = "file") %>%
  mutate(
    dataset_name     = ifelse(is.na(dataset_name), "unknown", dataset_name),
    `cb-narrow-desc` = ifelse(is.na(`cb-narrow-desc`), "unknown", `cb-narrow-desc`),
    `cb-broad-desc`  = ifelse(is.na(`cb-broad-desc`), "unknown", `cb-broad-desc`)
  )

# 5) Row ordering by dataset_name + cb-narrow-desc -------------------------

row_order <- row_meta %>%
  arrange(dataset_name, `cb-narrow-desc`, file) %>%
  pull(file)

stopifnot(length(row_order) == nrow(mat))
stopifnot(setequal(row_order, rownames(mat)))

# 6) Row annotation colors + right annotation (labels removed) -------------

dataset_levels <- unique(row_meta$dataset_name)
narrow_levels  <- unique(row_meta$`cb-narrow-desc`)
broad_levels   <- unique(row_meta$`cb-broad-desc`)

# Define the base palette (e.g., "Set3")
base_palette <- brewer.pal(brewer.pal.info["Set3", "maxcolors"], "Set3")
# Create a color function that can generate 30 colors
get_cols <- colorRampPalette(base_palette) 

row_cols <- list(
  dataset_name     = setNames(get_cols(length(dataset_levels)), dataset_levels),
  `cb-narrow-desc` = setNames(get_cols(length(narrow_levels)),  narrow_levels),
  `cb-broad-desc`  = setNames(get_cols(length(broad_levels)),   broad_levels)
)


right_ha <- rowAnnotation(
  dataset_name     = row_meta$dataset_name,
  `cb-narrow-desc` = row_meta$`cb-narrow-desc`,
  `cb-broad-desc`  = row_meta$`cb-broad-desc`,
  col = row_cols,
  simple_anno_size   = unit(1, "mm"),
  annotation_name_gp = gpar(fontsize = 0),   # hide annotation labels
  annotation_legend_param = list(
    labels_gp = gpar(fontsize = 6),          # <-- smaller legend labels
    title_gp  = gpar(fontsize = 7)           # <-- smaller legend titles
  ),
  show_legend = TRUE
)
# 7) Color scale for relative abundance ------------------------------------

max_val <- max(mat, na.rm = TRUE)

col_fun <- colorRamp2(
  c(0, 0.01, 0.05, max_val),
  c("white", "#440154FF", "#21908CFF", "#FDE725FF")
)

# 8) Heatmap: NO clustering; ordered by dataset_name + cb-narrow-desc ------

ht <- Heatmap(
  mat,
  name = "Rel. abundance",
  col  = col_fun,
  cluster_rows    = FALSE,
  row_order       = row_order,
  cluster_columns = FALSE,
  bottom_annotation = bottom_ha,
  right_annotation  = right_ha,
  show_row_names    = FALSE,
  column_names_gp   = gpar(fontsize = 4),
  column_names_rot  = 90,
  use_raster = FALSE
)

# 9) Save to PDF -----------------------------------------------------------

#pdf("file_subclass_rel_abundance_heatmap_grouped_by_dataset_cb_narrow.pdf",
#   width = 18, height = 10)
draw(ht)
#dev.off()

```



```{r}
# 1. Relative abundance per sample & subclass -----------------------------

rel_df <- df %>%
  count(sample_name, subclass_name, name = "count") %>%          # <-- sample_name (not dataset_name)
  group_by(sample_name) %>%
  mutate(p = count / sum(count)) %>%
  ungroup()

# 2. Map subclass -> superclass (class_name) ------------------------------

class_map <- df %>%
  distinct(subclass_name, class_name)

# 3. Build matrix: rows = samples, cols = subclasses ----------------------

mat_df <- rel_df %>%
  select(sample_name, subclass_name, p) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = subclass_name,
              values_from = p,
              values_fill = 0)

mat <- as.matrix(mat_df[, -1])
rownames(mat) <- mat_df$sample_name   # rownames are samples

# 4. Order subclasses by class_name then subclass_name --------------------

sub_order <- class_map %>%
  arrange(class_name, subclass_name) %>%
  pull(subclass_name)

sub_order <- intersect(sub_order, colnames(mat))
mat <- mat[, sub_order]

col_class <- class_map$class_name[
  match(colnames(mat), class_map$subclass_name)
]

# 5. Colors for superclass (columns) --------------------------------------

class_levels <- unique(col_class)
class_cols <- setNames(
  brewer.pal(length(class_levels), "Set2"),
  class_levels
)

bottom_ha <- HeatmapAnnotation(
  Class = col_class,
  col = list(Class = class_cols),
  annotation_name_gp = gpar(fontsize = 10),
  simple_anno_size = unit(4, "mm"),
  which = "column",
  show_legend = FALSE          # no auto legend for this annotation
)

# 6. Row metadata & right-side annotation (dataset + broad + narrow) ------

row_meta <- df %>%
  distinct(sample_name, dataset_name, cb_broad_desc, cb_narrow_desc)

# align row_meta to matrix row order
row_meta <- row_meta[match(rownames(mat), row_meta$sample_name), ]

# palettes for row annotations
dataset_levels <- unique(row_meta$dataset_name)
broad_levels   <- unique(row_meta$cb_broad_desc)
narrow_levels  <- unique(row_meta$cb_narrow_desc)

row_cols <- list(
  dataset = setNames(
    brewer.pal(max(3, length(dataset_levels)), "Set3")[seq_along(dataset_levels)],
    dataset_levels
  ),
  cb_broad_desc = setNames(
    brewer.pal(max(3, length(broad_levels)), "Dark2")[seq_along(broad_levels)],
    broad_levels
  ),
  cb_narrow_desc = setNames(
    brewer.pal(max(3, length(narrow_levels)), "Paired")[seq_along(narrow_levels)],
    narrow_levels
  )
)

right_ha <- rowAnnotation(
  dataset       = row_meta$dataset_name,
  cb_broad_desc = row_meta$cb_broad_desc,
  cb_narrow_desc= row_meta$cb_narrow_desc,
  col = row_cols,
  annotation_name_gp = gpar(fontsize = 10),
  simple_anno_size   = unit(3, "mm"),
  show_legend = FALSE      # keep legends manual & simple
)

# 7. Cluster rows (samples) -----------------------------------------------

row_dist <- vegdist(mat, method = "bray")   # or hellinger/canberra if you switch later
row_hc   <- hclust(row_dist, method = "average")

# 8. Color function for relative abundance --------------------------------

col_fun <- colorRamp2(
  c(0, 0.05, 0.10, max(mat)),
  c("white", "#440154FF", "#21908CFF", "#FDE725FF")
)

# 9. Heatmap object -------------------------------------------------------

ht <- Heatmap(
  mat,
  name = "Rel. abundance",
  col  = col_fun,
  cluster_rows    = row_hc,
  cluster_columns = FALSE,
  bottom_annotation = bottom_ha,
  right_annotation  = right_ha,      # <-- new row annotation block on the right
  show_heatmap_legend = FALSE,       # we’ll build legends manually
  row_names_gp    = gpar(fontsize = 10),
  column_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 7),
  column_names_rot = 90
)

# 10. Create legends manually & stack them --------------------------------

lgd_abund <- Legend(
  title   = "Rel. abundance",
  col_fun = col_fun,
  at      = c(0, 0.1, 0.3, 0.6),
  labels  = c("0", "0.1", "0.3", "0.6"),
  title_gp  = gpar(fontsize = 12),
  labels_gp = gpar(fontsize = 10)
)

lgd_class <- Legend(
  title = "Class",
  labels = names(class_cols),
  legend_gp = gpar(fill = class_cols),
  title_gp  = gpar(fontsize = 12),
  labels_gp = gpar(fontsize = 10)
)

combined_legends <- packLegend(
  lgd_abund,
  lgd_class,
  direction = "vertical",
  gap = unit(4, "mm")
)

# 11. Draw -----------------------------------------------------------------

png("sample_subclass_heatmap_with_annotations.png",
    width = 3400, height = 2000, res = 300)

ht_draw <- draw(ht, newpage = TRUE)

draw(
  combined_legends,
  x    = unit(1, "npc") + unit(5, "mm"),
  y    = unit(0.5, "npc"),
  just = c("left", "center")
)

dev.off()


```

```{r}
#Calculating Hill Number
# --- 1) file × Family (sample-level) ---
fam_wide <- df %>%
  filter(!is.na(file), !is.na(dataset_name), !is.na(Family)) %>%
  count(file, dataset_name, Family, name = "n") %>%                 # keeps dataset_name mapping
  pivot_wider(names_from = Family, values_from = n, values_fill = 0)

meta <- fam_wide %>% select(file, dataset_name)

# --- 2) Matrix for diversity ---
mat <- fam_wide %>%
  select(-dataset_name) %>%
  tibble::column_to_rownames("file") %>%
  as.matrix()

# --- 3) Alpha diversity per file (Shannon/Simpson/Richness + Hill q0,q1,q2) ---
alpha_by_file <- tibble(
  file     = rownames(mat),
  Shannon  = diversity(mat, index = "shannon"),
  Simpson  = diversity(mat, index = "simpson"),
  Richness = specnumber(mat),
  q0       = specnumber(mat),                    # Hill q=0 (richness)
  q1       = exp(diversity(mat, "shannon")),     # Hill q=1
  q2       = diversity(mat, "invsimpson")        # Hill q=2
) %>% left_join(meta, by = "file")

# --- 4) Plot: Hill number q = 1 (effective number of families) ---
# --- Make one plot: q0, q1, q2 together ---
alpha_long <- alpha_by_file %>%
  select(file, dataset_name, q0, q1, q2) %>%
  pivot_longer(c(q0, q1, q2), names_to = "metric", values_to = "value") %>%
  mutate(metric = factor(metric,
                         levels = c("q0","q1","q2"),
                         labels = c("q0 (Richness)", "q1 (exp[Shannon])", "q2 (Inverse Simpson)")),
         dataset_name = factor(dataset_name))

# Means for red dots/labels
# Compute means for red dots/labels
means_df <- alpha_long %>%
  group_by(dataset_name, metric) %>%
  summarise(mean_val = mean(value, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

ggplot(alpha_long, aes(x = dataset_name, y = value, fill = dataset_name)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.6) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.2, size = 1.6, alpha = 0.7) +
  # ⬇⬇ add x = dataset_name here
  geom_point(data = means_df,
             aes(x = dataset_name, y = mean_val),
             inherit.aes = FALSE, color = "red", size = 2.8) +
  geom_text(data = means_df,
            aes(x = dataset_name, y = mean_val, label = sprintf("%.2f", mean_val)),
            inherit.aes = FALSE, vjust = -0.6, color = "red", size = 3) +
  facet_wrap(~ metric, scales = "free_y", ncol = 1) +
  labs(title = "Hill numbers (Family level) per file by location",
       x = "Location (dataset_name)", y = "Effective number of families") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30, hjust = 1))
```




```{r}
#Family wide beta diversity
# 1) Meta
meta <- fam_wide %>% select(file, dataset_name)
rownames(meta) <- meta$file

# 2) Abundance: keep 'file' as rownames, drop 'dataset_name'
abund <- fam_wide %>%
  select(-dataset_name) %>%
  tibble::column_to_rownames("file")

# Make sure all columns are numeric
abund <- as.data.frame(lapply(abund, as.numeric), row.names = rownames(abund))


# --- 3) Hellinger transform (recommended for community data) ---
abund_hell <- decostand(abund, method = "hellinger")

# --- 4) Compute Bray–Curtis distances ---
bray <- vegdist(abund_hell, method = "bray")
```

```{r}
# 5) NMDS
set.seed(0)
nmds <- vegan::metaMDS(bray, k = 2, trymax = 100, autotransform = FALSE)

nmds_df <- as.data.frame(vegan::scores(nmds))
nmds_df$file <- rownames(nmds_df)
nmds_df <- dplyr::left_join(nmds_df, meta, by = "file")

ggplot(nmds_df, aes(NMDS1, NMDS2, color = dataset_name)) +
  geom_point(size = 3, alpha = 0.85) +
  stat_ellipse(level = 0.95, linetype = 2) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "NMDS (Bray–Curtis on Hellinger-transformed FAMs)",
       subtitle = paste("Stress =", round(nmds$stress, 3)))

```

```{r}
set.seed(42)

abund_hel <- decostand(abund, "hellinger")

set.seed(42)
emb2 <- uwot::umap(
  X         = as.matrix(abund_hel),
  metric    = "euclidean",
  n_neighbors = 15,
  min_dist    = 0.1,
  init        = "spectral",
  n_epochs    = 500
)

umap_df2 <- data.frame(UMAP1 = emb2[,1], UMAP2 = emb2[,2],
                       file = rownames(abund_hel)) %>%
  left_join(meta, by = "file")

ggplot(umap_df2, aes(UMAP1, UMAP2, color = dataset_name)) +
  geom_point(size = 2.4, alpha = 0.85) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "UMAP (Hellinger-transformed Family abundances)")

set.seed(42)

  X           = D,
  n_neighbors = min(15, nrow(D) - 1),

  n_epochs    = 500
)

) %>% left_join(meta, by = "file")

abund_hell2 <- decostand(abund2, method = "hellinger")

# --- 4) Compute Bray–Curtis distances ---
bray_class <- vegdist(abund_hell2, method = "bray")
```


```{r}
# 5) NMDS
set.seed(0)
nmds <- vegan::metaMDS(bray_class, k = 2, trymax = 100, autotransform = FALSE)

nmds_df <- as.data.frame(vegan::scores(nmds))
nmds_df$file <- rownames(nmds_df)
nmds_df <- dplyr::left_join(nmds_df, meta, by = "file")

ggplot(nmds_df, aes(NMDS1, NMDS2, color = dataset_name)) +
  geom_point(size = 3, alpha = 0.85) +
  stat_ellipse(level = 0.95, linetype = 2) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "NMDS (Bray–Curtis on Hellinger-transformed subclass_name)",
       subtitle = paste("Stress =", round(nmds$stress, 3)))

```
```{r}
D <- vegdist(decostand(abund2, "hellinger"), method = "bray")
ann <- data.frame(dataset_name = meta$dataset_name)
rownames(ann) <- rownames(meta)

# Use UPGMA on Bray for both axes
pheatmap(as.matrix(D),
         clustering_distance_rows = D,
         clustering_distance_cols = D,
         clustering_method = "average",
         annotation_row = ann,
         annotation_col = ann,
         show_rownames = FALSE, show_colnames = FALSE,
         main = "Bray–Curtis beta diversity subclass_name (sample × sample)")

```



```{r}
fam_wide <- fam_wide %>%
  mutate(environment_type = ifelse(dataset_name == "Gowanus-Core", "natural", "built"))

# Community distance (choose one)
# For very sparse data, use Jaccard
D_comm <- vegdist(decostand(abund, "pa"), method = "jaccard")
```

```{r}
#0->built; 1->natural
grp <- fam_wide$environment_type
D_envtype <- as.dist(outer(grp, grp, FUN = function(a, b) as.numeric(a != b)))
attr(D_envtype, "Labels") <- rownames(meta)

```

```{r}
set.seed(1)
mantel_env <- mantel(D_comm, D_envtype, method = "pearson", permutations = 9999)
print(mantel_env)
```
